page.overview:
What is Dunsparce?

This Dunsparce is a -type Pokémon in Mystery Dungeon Gates to Infinity Animated Trailer.

When Umbreon and Espeon opened the Magnagate, Dunsparce was one of the Pokémon to enter the portal. However, during the adventure in the ice chamber, Dunsparce, along with all other Pokémon in the team except Oshawott, fell unconscious.

None of Dunsparce's moves are known. Category:Normal-type anime Pokémon Category:"Pokémon that can Talk" Category:Mystery Dungeon characters
